title: Simulation & Backtest Methodology
acceptance_criteria: Document the actual Monte Carlo assumptions: return/volatility distribution, timestep, number of simulations, contribution timing, fees, inflation treatment, and reported percentiles, and explain why Monte Carlo is used (it is a projection, not a prediction).
Distinguish clearly between Portfolio Historical Statistics, Market Scenario, and Custom assumption modes, and show the actual runtime values used in each.
For historical simulation, use real prices, a common valid start date across holdings, and never fill data before an ETF's inception.
State the actual rebalance convention implemented; only describe it as monthly if the code actually rebalances monthly.
Correctly account for contributions, total invested, portfolio value/gain, fractional-share assumptions, and dated cash flows for any XIRR calculation.
Disclose whether each simulation path is fixed-allocation or walk-forward, and audit for look-ahead bias.
Add methodology metadata/UI and deterministic automated tests covering the above.
prohibited: No ETF application/business-logic changes outside of this task's methodology and disclosure scope.
Do not introduce new external data sources or paid APIs.
